def mmax(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); R=[]
    for rr in range(h):
        for cc in range(w):
            for r2 in range(rr+1,h):
                for c2 in range(cc+1,w):
                    if not all(g[a][b]==0 for a in range(rr,r2+1) for b in range(cc,c2+1)): continue
                    if rr>0 and all(g[rr-1][b]==0 for b in range(cc,c2+1)): continue
                    if r2+1<h and all(g[r2+1][b]!=0 for b in range(cc,c2+1)): continue
                    if cc>0 and all(g[a][cc-1]==0 for a in range(rr,r2+1)): continue
                    if c2+1<w and all(g[a][c2+1]==0 for a in range(cc,c2+1)): continue
                    R.append((rr,r2,cc,c2))
    return R
